title: Stochastically forced Navier-Stokes equations interacting with an elastic structure
summary: We prove global-in-time strong pathwise well-posedness for a stochastic fluid-structure interaction problem coupling a two-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes fluid to a one-dimensional damped Kirchhoff plate. The coupling is imposed on a fixed interface through continuity of velocities and balance of normal stresses, and stochastic forcing, modeled by a cylindrical Wiener process, acts on both the fluid and structure equations.
